ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِه وَعَلَى آدَمَ وَنُوْحٍ وَ إِبْرَاهِيْمَ وَ مُوْسَى وَ عِيْسَى وَمَا بَيْنَهُمْ مِنَ النَّبِيِّنَ وَ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ صَلَوَاتُ اللّٰهِ وَسَلَامُهُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِيْنَ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa `alā Ādama wa Nūḥin wa Ibrāhīma wa Mūsā wa `Īsā, Wa mā bayna hum min ‘n-Nabiyyīna wa ‘l-Mursalīna, ṣalawātu ‘lLāhi wa salāmuhū `ālay him ajma`īn.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and Adam, Noah, Abraham, Moses, Jesus, and all Prophets and Messengers between them, Allah's prayers and peace be upon them altogether.
blocks.review: النَّبِيِّنَ: marks under the doubled yā are small; read as shadda+kasra with no second yā/standing kasra (transliteration has Nabiyyīna). Line-end dot is a small filled diamond, given as '.'.

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا جِبْرِيْلَ وَ مِيْكَائِيْلَ وَ إِسْرَافِيْلَ وَ عَزْرَائِيْلَ وَ حَمَلَةِ الْعَرْشِ وَ عَلَى الْمَلٰٓئِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبِيْنَ صَلَوَاتُ اللّٰهِ وَ سَلَامُهُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِيْنَ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Jibrīla wa Mīkā’īla wa Isrāfīla wa `Azrā’īla, Wa hamalati ‘l-`Arshi wa `alā ‘l-Malā’ikati ‘l-Muqarrabīna, Ṣalawātu ‘lLāhi wa salāmuhū `alay him ajma`īn.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Gabriel, Michael, Israfeel, Azra'eel, Throne Bearers and Close Angels, Allah's prayers and peace be upon them all!
blocks.review: الْمَلٰٓئِكَةِ: read as lām with dagger alif + madda (no full alif); the mark over the lām is small.
